caption:
⛰️ The whole world, sorted by daily income — 1800 → 2024.

In 1800, 74% of humanity lived on less than $2 a day. By 2020, 4.9% — one person in twenty. Watch the mountain split after 1950 as a richer hump pulls away, poverty peak at 1.46 billion people in 1980, then Asia's growth drag the whole curve to the right.

📊 Data: Gapminder Income Mountains v3, from World Bank PIP (CC BY 4.0). 2017 PPP dollars; figures before 1980 are modelled estimates.
